detail.visual: White distressed bold uppercase AWESOME / LIKE MY / DAUGHTER in three separated centered lines; no illustration.

comparisons.815177081: Direct Etsy image and seller: VahDiDesign / Andriy. Distressed uppercase AWESOME / LIKE MY / DAUGHTER, red/yellow/teal, tightly stacked, LIKE MY taller than other rows. Same wording plus three-line distressed typographic arrangement; different colour, spacing and proportions. No origin/creator relationship to Crazy Dog established.
comparisons.theshirtrepublic.com/products/awesome-li: Direct image: clean condensed white two-line AWESOME LIKE / MY DAUGHTER, no distress. Shared short family phrase by itself is not sufficient match; layout differs.

decision.basis: Short family phrase alone is generic. However the directly inspected VahDiDesign apparel retains exact three-line segmentation and distressed uppercase typographic arrangement; colour, spacing and relative letter height differ. Specific wording-plus-composition recurrence remains untraced between sellers under frozen v0.3. Shirt Republic two-line clean lettering is separately recorded as distinct.
decision.limitations: No priority or infringement finding. Etsy designer label establishes a claim, not a provenance bridge. Six mandatory runs complete; generic phrase alone not used as quarantine basis.
